note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes SharePointTenantSettings.Read.All, Reports.Read.All, ReportSettings.ReadWrite.All, Organization.Read.All -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser)
# values to write down (the episode changes nothing in the tenant); the baseline is edited against them

$s = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/admin/sharepoint/settings -OutputType PSObject; $s | Select-Object personalSiteDefaultStorageLimitInMB, deletedUserPersonalSiteRetentionPeriodInDays, isUnmanagedSyncAppForTenantRestricted, isSyncButtonHiddenOnPersonalSite, isMacSyncAppEnabled

$c = Get-Content ./src/onedrive-baseline.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $c.accounts.inactiveDays = 3; $c.accounts.nearFullPercent = 90; $c.settings.deletedUserPersonalSiteRetentionPeriodInDays = [int]$s.deletedUserPersonalSiteRetentionPeriodInDays + 7; $c | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content ./src/onedrive-baseline.lab.json   # one real difference on purpose; the lab is days old, production inactiveDays is 180
(Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/admin/reportSettings).displayConcealedNames   # must be True: first beat of the audit screen
# the VM: start it, checkpoint it, copy src and the tenant id to C:\mg (unzip it inside the VM in the first step of the apply screen)

$zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-ep12-src.zip'; Remove-Item $zip -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Compress-Archive -Path ./src/* -DestinationPath $zip; Copy-VMFile -VMName CON-W11-01 -SourcePath $zip -DestinationPath C:\mg\ -FileSource Host -CreateFullPath -Force

$tf = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mglab-tenant.txt'; Set-Content $tf (Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Uri /v1.0/organization).value[0].id; Copy-VMFile -VMName CON-W11-01 -SourcePath $tf -DestinationPath C:\mg\ -FileSource Host -CreateFullPath -Force; Remove-Item $tf

screens.name: settings
steps: Open OneDrive: show Storage limit (default) and Retention (days to keep a deleted user's OneDrive; documented default 30)
Open Sync: show the real values, change nothing
mask: tenant name in the top bar and admin URL

screens.name: audit
commands: # clear 'Conceal user, group, and site names in all reports' (admin center > Settings > Org settings > Services > Reports); same setting through Graph:

screens.name: apply
screens.app: Hyper-V Virtual Machine Connection (VMConnect) to CON-W11-01, elevated PowerShell 7 as alex.demo
steps: In the VM, elevated PowerShell 7: Expand-Archive C:\mg\mglab-ep12-src.zip C:\mg\src -Force; cd C:\mg\src
Type: Test-Path HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\OneDrive   (False: a clean first run)
Type: Get-Content .\onedrive-policy.rollback.json   (it records that the values did not exist before; the tenant id in it is masked)
Open regedit at HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\OneDrive to show the real values
If anything fails (the real registry provider may not accept New-ItemProperty -PropertyType -Force as the mocks assume), record the error: it is a finding for the code
mask: tenant id in the commands, the output, the rollback file and regedit

screens.name: result
screens.app: VMConnect to CON-W11-01 (File Explorer, OneDrive) and a browser on the lab tenant
steps: In the VM: start OneDrive (it signs in alex.demo silently with the Windows account, SilentAccountConfig)
Show File Explorer: Desktop, Documents and Pictures now under the OneDrive folder; right-click Documents > Properties > Location; the status icons
If nothing moves within a few minutes, say so on camera and show the Sync Activity Center: do not cut it, do not stage it
Browser, https://www.office.com/launch/onedrive as alex.demo: OneDrive shows the same three folders and files
mask: profile path if it shows the tenant name

teardown: Restore-VMCheckpoint -VMName CON-W11-01 -Name pre-mglab-ep12 -Confirm:$false; Remove-VMCheckpoint -VMName CON-W11-01 -Name pre-mglab-ep12   # undoes the policy values, known-folder redirection and C:\mg on the VM
Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method PATCH -Uri /v1.0/admin/reportSettings -Body @{ displayConcealedNames = $true }   # the privacy default again
Stop-VM -Name CON-W11-01   # optional: shut the VM down
# by hand: put taylor.demo's storage maximum back and delete the files uploaded for the demo; delete casey.former permanently if it was created
needs: vm:CON-W11-01 (Windows 11, Entra joined as alex.demo, from episode 7)
manual:a few days earlier the lab users upload files to their OneDrive; taylor.demo storage maximum 1 GB with over 900 MB uploaded (NearFull)
wait:a few days for usage report data
